sessionStart.prompt: Read AGENTS.md and .github/copilot-instructions.md to understand project conventions. This is MyCodeXvantaOS — a Local-first, Provider-agnostic, Contract-driven platform. Always run npm run typecheck before committing.

postToolUse.bash: TOOL="${COPILOT_HOOK_TOOL_NAME:-unknown}"; if echo "$TOOL" | grep -q 'write'; then echo '{"additionalContext": "File modified. Remember to run npm run typecheck before completing."}'; fi

agentStop.bash: cd "${COPILOT_HOOK_CWD:-.}" 2>/dev/null; RESULT=$(npm run typecheck 2>&1); EXIT=$?; if [ $EXIT -ne 0 ]; then ERRORS=$(echo "$RESULT" | grep -c 'error TS' || echo '0'); echo "{\"decision\": \"block\", \"reason\": \"TypeScript compilation failed with $ERRORS error(s). Fix all type errors before completing.\", \"additionalContext\": \"$(echo "$RESULT" | tail -5 | tr '\n' ' ')\"}"; else echo '{"decision": "allow"}'; fi

subagentStart.bash: echo '{"additionalContext": "You are working in the MyCodeXvantaOS monorepo. Follow conventions in AGENTS.md. Run npm run typecheck before completing."}'

errorOccurred.bash: echo "[$(date -Iseconds)] ERROR: ${COPILOT_HOOK_ERROR_MESSAGE:-unknown error}" >> /tmp/copilot-errors.log 2>/dev/null; echo '{"additionalContext": "An error occurred. Check the error message and try an alternative approach."}'

sessionEnd.bash: echo "Session ended at $(date -Iseconds). Cleaning up temporary files." && rm -f /tmp/copilot-errors.log /tmp/copilot-session-errors.log 2>/dev/null || true
